description: This file contains styles for a Tic Tac Toe frontend application, defining various themes, layouts, and components visual styles.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application container that ensures the entire app takes up the full viewport height.

classes.name: ttt-title
classes.description: Styles for the title of the Tic Tac Toe game, including font size and color.

classes.name: ttt-game-area
classes.description: Container styles for the game area with padding and display properties.

classes.name: ttt-square
classes.description: Styles for each square in the Tic Tac Toe board, including size, alignment, and transition effects.

classes.name: ttt-reset-btn
classes.description: Button styles for the reset button used to reset the game.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Styles for the button that toggles between light and dark themes.
